title: Joining Willie Bryant as an arranger because of the union
summary: Willie Bryant's band recommended him; he was made an arranger since the union barred him from playing, and he stayed about six months with Benny Carter, Cozy Cole and Teddy Wilson.

Yeah, because I was playing but they had to make me an arranger because the union wouldn't let me play, unless I become a member in so many months, you know, and it changed the whole status of the band. It was Peekaboo Jimmy, I'll never forget.
How long were you with them?
I must have been with Willy about six months, maybe, not that -- yeah, that's about all. I went to Jimmy Lunsford's band, I think.
But Willy's band was pretty good at that time.
Was Benny Carter in it when you --
Benny Carter was playing the alto. Lorenzo Pack and Johnny Russell and Cozy Cole.
